shortDescription: Create or drop indexes from a PostgreSQL database

options.name: ca_cert
options.description: Specifies the name of a file containing SSL certificate authority (CA) certificate(s). If the file exists, the server's certificate will be verified to be signed by one of these authorities.

options.name: cascade
options.description: Automatically drop objects that depend on the index, and in turn all objects that depend on those objects. It used only with I(state=absent). Mutually exclusive with I(concurrent=true).

options.name: columns
options.description: List of index columns that need to be covered by index. Mutually exclusive with I(state=absent).

options.name: concurrent
options.description: Enable or disable concurrent mode (CREATE / DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY). Pay attention, if I(concurrent=false), the table will be locked (ACCESS EXCLUSIVE) during the building process. For more information about the lock levels see U(https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/explicit-locking.html). If the building process was interrupted for any reason when I(cuncurrent=true), the index becomes invalid. In this case it should be dropped and created again. Mutually exclusive with I(cascade=true).

options.name: cond
options.description: Index conditions. Mutually exclusive with I(state=absent).

options.name: connect_params
options.description: Any additional parameters to be passed to libpg. These parameters take precedence.

options.name: idxname
options.description: Name of the index to create or drop.

options.name: idxtype
options.description: Index type (like btree, gist, gin, etc.). Mutually exclusive with I(state=absent).

options.name: login_db
options.description: Name of database to connect to and where the index will be created/dropped. The V(db) alias is deprecated and will be removed in version 5.0.0.

options.name: login_host
options.description: Host running the database. If you have connection issues when using C(localhost), try to use C(127.0.0.1) instead.

options.name: login_password
options.description: The password this module should use to establish its PostgreSQL session.

options.name: login_port
options.description: Database port to connect to. The C(port) alias is deprecated and will be removed in the next major release. Use C(login_port) instead.

options.name: login_unix_socket
options.description: Path to a Unix domain socket for local connections.

options.name: login_user
options.description: The username this module should use to establish its PostgreSQL session.

options.name: schema
options.description: Name of a database schema where the index will be created.

options.name: session_role
options.description: Switch to session_role after connecting. The specified session_role must be a role that the current login_user is a member of. Permissions checking for SQL commands is carried out as though the session_role were the one that had logged in originally.

options.name: ssl_cert
options.description: Specifies the file name of the client SSL certificate.

options.name: ssl_key
options.description: Specifies the location for the secret key used for the client certificate.

options.name: ssl_mode
options.description: Determines whether or with what priority a secure SSL TCP/IP connection will be negotiated with the server. See U(https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/static/libpq-ssl.html) for more information on the modes. Default of C(prefer) matches libpq default.

options.name: state
options.description: Index state. C(present) implies the index will be created if it does not exist. C(absent) implies the index will be dropped if it exists.

options.name: storage_params
options.description: Storage parameters like fillfactor, vacuum_cleanup_index_scale_factor, etc. Mutually exclusive with I(state=absent).

options.name: table
options.description: Table to create index on it. Mutually exclusive with I(state=absent).

options.name: tablespace
options.description: Set a tablespace for the index. Mutually exclusive with I(state=absent).

options.name: trust_input
options.description: If C(false), check whether values of parameters I(idxname), I(session_role), I(schema), I(table), I(columns), I(tablespace), I(storage_params), I(cond) are potentially dangerous. It makes sense to use C(false) only when SQL injections via the parameters are possible.

options.name: unique
options.description: Enable unique index. Only btree currently supports unique indexes.
